provenance.purpose: Separate "more data does not help" from "each example seen only once". 552/cell x 2 epochs = 4416 updates, i.e. 2x the compute of both prior balanced runs, each example seen twice (matching the 254/cell run epoch count).
provenance.sources: PrimeVul time-disjoint train, PatchEval all, DeltaSecommits all (v2), CrossVul non-held-out
provenance.epochs_rationale: 2 epochs on 2208 pairs. Compare against 254/cell x 2ep (2032 updates, each example twice) and 552/cell x 1ep (2208 updates, each example once).
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul pairs (excluding the 350 v4 eval keys) are now TRAINING data. CrossVul eval numbers for this checkpoint are therefore no longer zero-shot. The three other sources remain clean.
